benefits.titleZh: 讓合適的人知道最新情況
benefits.zh: copy somebody in 可以確保另一個人收到相同的電郵或訊息。
benefits.en: Copy somebody in lets you make sure another person receives the same emails or messages.

benefits.titleZh: 在忘記前保存簡短資料
benefits.titleEn: Save short details before you forget them
benefits.zh: 你可以用 copy down 抄下電話號碼、地址、日期、時間和密碼。
benefits.en: Use copy down for phone numbers, addresses, dates, times and codes.

benefits.zh: 需要完整抄寫食譜、詩歌、文章或一整套指示時，可以使用 copy out。
benefits.en: Use copy out when you need the whole recipe, poem, passage or set of instructions.

benefits.titleZh: 分清不同類型的抄寫和傳送副本
benefits.titleEn: Choose the right kind of copying
benefits.zh: copy down 通常用於簡短資料，copy out 用於完整文字，而 copy somebody in 則用於電郵或訊息溝通。
benefits.en: Copy down is normally for short information, copy out is for a complete text, and copy somebody in is used in communication.
